title: The Whispered Caverns of June Serin

dmosDndConversion.reason: Quest source uses a normal-person/first-level premise. D&D level must be chosen after full encounter and clue extraction.

hardCanon: Landry Horn is an old friend of the player characters and works as a miner in June Serin.
Landry sends a coded plea for help.
Mining teams in the lowest Whispered Caverns lose memories of complete shifts.
Those shifts produce three to four times normal quantities of suspiciously pure ore.
The cause of the anomalies is secret and may not be invented by the AI DM.

scenes.title: Landry's Coded Plea
requiredFacts: Landry is working in June Serin.
The letter is coded and urgently asks for help.
The party chooses to take up the call.

suggestedChoices.label: Research June Serin and the Whispered Caverns before leaving
Ask mutual contacts what they know about Landry's situation
